title: Broadway Starz at Class Act Performing Arts Studio: Parent Insights
summary: This report analyzes the Broadway Starz program at Class Act Performing Arts Studio, focusing on program quality and accessibility based on information available on their website. The summary highlights key strengths for parents considering enrollment.

sections.title: Key Strengths and Highlights of Broadway Starz
sections.content:
* **Creative Collaboration:** Students ages 3-6 collaboratively create and perform shows based on weekly themes [1].
* **Performance Showcase:** Parents are invited to the last 15 minutes each week to view their children's performance [1].
* **Skill Development:** The program fosters creativity, storytelling through movement, and singing abilities [1].
* **Convenient Scheduling:** Weekly sessions run Monday-Friday from 9:30am-12:30pm, offering a structured schedule [1].
* **Deposit Flexibility:** The $100 non-refundable deposit can be transferred to another camp week if needed [1].
